task_name: Uncalled4 Nanopore Signal Alignment and m6A Detection Analysis
scientific_objective: Evaluate Uncalled4 toolkit for nanopore signal alignment enabling sensitive detection of DNA and RNA modifications
methodological_commitments: Performance benchmarking across 4 sequencing chemistries (DNA r9.4, DNA r10.4, RNA001, RNA004)
Comparison of 4 tools: Uncalled4, f5c, Nanopolish, Tombo
m6A modification detection using precision-recall and ROC analysis
Ground truth validation using GLORI/m6A-Atlas labels
Pore model characterization across different k-mer lengths
required_comparison_tables: Performance benchmarks by tool and chemistry
expected_figure_families: Performance bar charts (time and file size)
Current std vs mean scatter plots
